purpose: Database functions and columns singles-api depends on. The deploy lane refuses to ship singles-api unless every one exists in production, so migrations always land before the code that needs them.
release_path: Orchestrator convergence (scripts/converge-orchestrated-pr-merge.mjs) dispatches deploy-singles-api.yml right after merging an ai/<agent>/orch_* release that touches this lane. Bot-token merges emit no push event, so the push trigger only covers human-authored merges. See docs/EKODI-SINGLES-API-DEPLOY-LANE.md.
